n: 1.6 cu.ft Electric Stacked Laundry Center 6 Wash cycles and AutoDry™
desc: Wash and dry all the essentials with a stacked laundry center that accommodates small spaces. The see-through EasyView™ Glass Lidlets you easily check on your load while it's washing and the dryer automatically senses when clothes are dry to prevent overdrying.
hl: EasyView™ Glass Lid with Slow-Close Technology
Enjoy a clean, streamlined look with the see-through lid with slow-close hinge that lets you easily check on your load while it's washing.
Give clothes a thorough and gentle clean with the impeller that drives clothes from the outer rim to the center, where the deepest clean happens.
Help prevent overdrying with the AutoDry™ drying system that senses when clothes have reached the right moisture content and stops the cycle.
Smooth Wave Stainless Steel Wash Basket
Give clothes the care they need with the sleek pattern of the stainless steel wash basket that gently guides them.
Choose the right setting for each load when you dry with Normal, Delicate, Air Only or Timed Dry cycles.
Wash the essentials with 1.6 cu. ft. capacity.
